scripts.dev: bun run --filter @k5-work/shared build && concurrently -n server,web "bun run --filter server dev" "bun run --filter react-vite-tailwind dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort"
scripts.build: bun run --filter @k5-work/shared build && bun run --filter server build && bun run --filter react-vite-tailwind build
scripts.test: bun run --filter @k5-work/shared test && bun run --filter server test && bun run --filter react-vite-tailwind test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @k5-work/shared typecheck && bun run --filter server typecheck && bun run --filter react-vite-tailwind typecheck
